financials.methodology: SOURCES AND APPROACH. FY1977-FY1980: taken directly from the primary source — Apple Computer, Inc. Initial Public Offering Prospectus, December 12, 1980 (scanned PDF, text-extracted and read in full: https://www.swtpc.com/files/mholley/apple/apple_ipo.pdf ; independent mirror https://deramp.com/swtpc.com/Apple/Apple_IPO.pdf). Specifically: Consolidated Statement of Income (p.37), Consolidated Balance Sheet (pp.38-39, FY1979/FY1980 only), Consolidated Statement of Shareholders' Equity (p.40), Consolidated Statement of Changes in Financial Position (p.41), Selected Financial Data (p.3/p.8), and the "Employees" section (~1,015 full-time at Sep 26, 1980). Cross-checked against TechCrunch "A look back in IPO: Apple, the early PC purveyor" (Sep 15, 2017, https://techcrunch.com/2017/09/15/a-look-back-in-ipo-apple-the-early-pc-purveyor/ — confirms FY1977 net income $41,575, ~10x FY1978 revenue growth, ~6x FY1979, ~2x FY1980, $11.7M FY1980 profit) and wallstreetnumbers.com/stocks/aapl (Compustat-style history: FY1980 revenue $117.13M, net income $11.70M). FY1981-FY1985: Apple's paper 10-Ks are not on EDGAR (Apple's electronic filings begin 1994), and no digitized 1981-85 annual report was found, so figures are from: (1) Fortune 500 archive (CNN/Money, via Wayback Machine) — 1983 list/snapshot (FY1982: revenue 583.1, profit 61.3, assets 357.8, equity 257.1, employees 3,391, EPS 1982 $1.06 and 1981 $0.70), 1984 snapshot (FY1983: revenue 982.8, profit 76.7, assets 556.6, equity 377.9, employees 4,645, EPS 1983 $1.28), 1985 list (FY1984: revenue 1,515.9, profit 64.1), 1986 list (FY1985: revenue 1,918.3, profit 61.2), 1987 snapshot (EPS 1985 $0.99); (2) UPI wire report Oct 17, 1985 (https://www.upi.com/Archives/1985/10/17/...7261498369600/): FY1985 sales $1.9B, earnings $61.2M, EPS $0.99; FY1984 sales $1.5B, earnings $64.1M, EPS $1.05; FY ended Sep 27, 1985; (3) HBS case 706-496 "Apple Computer, 2006" Exhibit 1a (Standard & Poor's Compustat data; PDF via Google Groups): FY1981 net sales 334, cost of sales 170, R&D 21, SG&A 77, net income 39, total assets 255, shareholders' equity 177, employees 2,456, no dividends; (4) wallstreetnumbers.com (Compustat-derived): revenue 334.78/583.06/982.77/1,515.9(1.52B)/1,918.3(1.92B) and net income 39.42/61.31/76.71/64.06/61.22 for FY1981-85. Every year's revenue+netIncome is corroborated by at least two independent sources. UNITS AND CONVENTIONS. All money in US$ millions. "Revenue" = net sales as reported (prospectus also shows total revenues incl. interest income: FY1978 $7.883M, FY1979 $47.939M, FY1980 $117.902M). EPS: in this era Apple reported a single "earnings per common and common equivalent share" (APB 15 primary EPS); no separate basic/fully-diluted split was disclosed in the sources found, so the as-reported figure is recorded under epsDiluted (it includes common-stock equivalents) and epsBasic is null — FY1977 EPS was reported only as "less than $.01", so both are null. Per-share data for FY1977-80 are as presented in the Dec 1980 prospectus (adjusted for Apple's pre-IPO stock splits, per prospectus Note 1) and are NOT adjusted for the later 2:1 (1987), 2:1 (2000), 2:1 (2005), 7:1 (2014), 4:1 (2020) splits; FY1981-85 EPS are as reported at the time (also unadjusted for later splits). dividendsPerShare = 0 for all nine years: the prospectus states no dividends had ever been paid, the Compustat exhibit shows none in 1981, and Apple's first cash dividend came in 1987. sharesOutstandingM = weighted-average common and common-equivalent shares used in the EPS calculation (prospectus, FY1977-80 only; not found as-reported for FY1981-85 — null). totalDebt = interest-bearing borrowings excluding capital-lease obligations: FY1979 $0 and FY1980 $9.10M ($7.85M bank notes payable under a $20M line + $1.25M note payable) per the prospectus balance sheet (capital-lease obligations excluded: FY1979 $0.225M, FY1980 $0.925M); FY1977 ($0.15M) and FY1978 ($0) are derived arithmetically from the prospectus Statement of Changes in Financial Position (notes payable to bank +$150,000 in FY1977, -$150,000 in FY1978); FY1981-85 null (not stated in any located source). operatingCashFlow is null for ALL years — pre-SFAS 95 (adopted FY1988+) Apple published a working-capital-basis "Statement of Changes in Financial Position", not a cash-basis operating cash flow ("working capital provided from operations" was $49,632 / $855,553 / $5,449,150 / $13,822,361 for FY1977-80 — deliberately NOT mapped to OCF). capitalExpenditure = "Additions to property, plant and equipment" from the prospectus funds statement (FY1977-80 only). NULLS AND PRECISION. Nothing is estimated or interpolated. FY1981-85 balance-sheet/employee figures are only populated where Fortune or Compustat state them (FY1984-85 total assets, equity, employees, R&D, pretax, taxes not located in an authoritative free source — null; Fortune snapshots for the 1985/1986 lists are not archived in Wayback). FY1981-85 figures carry millions-level precision (Fortune/Compustat rounding, e.g. FY1984 revenue 1,515.9 vs the 10-K's thousands-level figure); FY1977-80 figures are exact from the prospectus (dollar-level, expressed in millions to 3-4 decimals). Fortune employee counts are Fortune's fiscal-year-end tallies, not verified against the underlying 10-K wording on "permanent full-time". FY1977 is an ~9-month inception period (Jan 3, 1977 to Sep 30, 1977). Fiscal years end the last Saturday of September (FY1978/79 ended Sep 30; FY1980 Sep 26; FY1985 Sep 27 per UPI).

financials.methodology: All figures in US$ millions except per-share (US$, as originally reported that year, NOT adjusted for later splits) and shares (millions, weighted-average common and common-equivalent as reported). Apple fiscal years end the last Friday/Saturday of September (FY1986 ended 9/26/86 ... FY1993 ended 9/24/93). PRIMARY SOURCES (verified directly on SEC EDGAR, fetched 2026-08-16): (1) Apple 424B5 debt-offering prospectus filed 1994-01-26, Acc. 0000891618-94-000021 - 'Selected Consolidated Financial Information' table derived from Ernst & Young-audited statements covering FY1989-1993 (income statement detail incl. R&D, pretax, taxes; TA, notes payable, equity; dividends declared; capex); (2) Apple FY1994 10-K, Acc. 0000320193-94-000016 - Item 6 selected data (FY1990-1994: revenue, NI, EPS, dividends, shares, TA, LTD), full FY1992-1994 income/cash-flow statements, FY1993/94 balance sheets, shareholders'-equity statement (year-end equity 1991-1994), Schedule IX short-term borrowings (year-end balances 1992-1994); (3) Apple FY1995 10-K, Acc. 0000320193-95-000016 (Item 6, FY1991-1995) as cross-check. Every FY1989-1993 revenue/NI figure appears in at least two independent SEC documents. FY1986-1988 (pre-EDGAR; Apple's paper 10-Ks are not online): revenue, net income, total assets and stockholders' equity from the Fortune 500 archive Apple snapshots (1987/1988/1989 lists = FY1986/87/88, via Wayback Machine captures of money.cnn.com/magazines/fortune/fortune500_archive/snapshots/{1987,1988,1989}/114.html), cross-checked against the Hoover's Handbook of American Business 1991 Apple 10-year financial table (extracted from the Hoover's CD-ROM image on archive.org, item hoovers-handbook-...-1991) and Apple's own Corporate Timeline PDF (June 1995, apple2.org.za mirror) which states FY1988 net sales $4.07B / NI $400.3M and FY1989 $454.0M / $3.53 EPS / $5.284B - the FY1989 overlap between Fortune, Hoover's and the SEC 424B5 matches exactly, validating those secondary sources. EPS 1987-1993 and dividends per share 1987-1989 from Hoover's as-reported table (1.65 / 3.08 / 3.53; 0.12 / 0.32 / 0.40), consistent with Apple's timeline (first quarterly dividend $0.06 post-split declared April 1987 alongside the 2:1 June 1987 split) and with SEC-filed values for 1989-1993 (0.40 / 0.44 / 0.48 / 0.48 / 0.48). In this era Apple reported a single 'earnings per common and common equivalent share' (primary EPS); that one as-reported number is entered in both epsBasic and epsDiluted with no restatement. totalDebt = year-end short-term borrowings + long-term debt from SEC filings (FY1989 LTD $0 per Hoover's 'debt ratio 0.0%'). NOTHING IS ESTIMATED OR INTERPOLATED: fields are null wherever no authoritative accessible source states the figure - notably FY1986-1988 R&D/cash-flow/debt/shares/pretax/taxes, FY1986-1991 operating cash flow, and employees for most years (pre-FY1994 10-K employee counts are on paper filings only; FY1986's ~5,500 is Apple's own approximate wording from the 1986 Annual Report). Per-row notes flag every rounding limitation (Fortune rounds FY1987/88 assets/equity to $1M; FY1987 NI 218.0 is the sourced rounded value vs the commonly cited unverified $217.5M) and special items (FY1989 Adobe gain, FY1991/93 restructuring charges, FY1993 negative operating cash flow).

All figures transcribed directly from Apple Computer, Inc.'s own 10-K filings on SEC EDGAR (CIK 0000320193), fetched as the original full-text documents: FY1994 acc. 0000320193-94-000016 (filed 1994-12-13), FY1995 acc. 0000320193-95-000016 (1995-12-19), FY1996 acc. 0000320193-96-000023 (1996-12-19), FY1997 acc. 0001047469-97-006960 (1997-12-05), FY1998 10-K405 acc. 0001047469-98-044981 (1998-12-23), FY1999 acc. 0000912057-99-010244 (1999-12-22), FY2000 acc. 0000912057-00-053623 doc a2032880z10-k.txt (2000-12-14). Money in US$ millions.
